shortDescription: W. P. Carey NYSE:WPC on Thursday announced an improved 2026 outlook for estimated rent loss from tenant credit events and strong investment volume, expecting to update its full-year guidance in the third-quarter financial results release.Shares were 0.31% higher at $70.17 during pre-market trading…

children: an improved 2026 outlook for estimated rent loss from tenant credit events and strong investment volume, expecting to update its full-year guidance in the third-quarter financial results release.
Shares were 0.31% higher at $70.17 during pre-market trading.
The net lease REIT said it has received the August rent from Hellweg and expects to collect additional rent from the client during the second half.
Furthermore, W. P. Carey expects to recognize the benefit of bank guarantees to cover up to three months of lease-related damages associated with Hellweg.
Additionally, the company sees investment volume totaling over $1.9B for 2026, with ~$1.4B of investment volume completed year to date.

"We've also made further progress addressing Hellweg, which, together with improved visibility into expected Hellweg rent over the second half of the year, has improved our outlook for rent loss this year," said CEO Jason Fox.

"As a result, we're confident that AFFO is on track to end the year above the midpoint of our current guidance range, and we look forward to updating our full-year expectations when we report our third-quarter results," said Fox.

title: W. P. Carey to revise 2026 financial guidance in Q3 earnings release
